requirement_correction.transition: An explicit user correction replaces the north destination and leaves the backup constraint applicable.
requirement_correction.availability: The source retains both original user messages, the replacement, and the correction edge. The retired destination is recoverable as history.
requirement_correction.context_text: Prepare the local relay transfer from the recorded instructions.

R-BACKUP.text: Keep a backup of the route register in the lighthouse safe.

R-NORTH.text: Send the relay to North Quay.

before.prerequisite: Use the North Quay instruction with the route-register backup constraint.
forbidden_claims: The destination has already changed.
The backup constraint is optional.

R-BACKUP.text: Keep a backup of the route register in the lighthouse safe.

R-SOUTH.text: Send the relay to South Quay.

after.prerequisite: Use South Quay and preserve the route-register backup.
forbidden_claims: North Quay is current.
The destination correction also canceled the backup.

pending_tool.transition: E15 reconciles the same T42 operation started by E14 after an earlier plan.
pending_tool.availability: The start is committed without a result. The exact terminal receipt becomes available only when E15 is appended and ingested.
pending_tool.context_text: Continue the maintenance decision from the recorded inspection evidence.

E12.text: Check the lamp test outcome before choosing the next inspection.

before.prerequisite: Wait for a terminal receipt for the already-started operation.
forbidden_claims: The test has succeeded.
A second launch is necessary for continuity.

E12.text: Check the lamp test outcome before choosing the next inspection.

after.prerequisite: Use E15 as the receipt for the operation that started at E14.
forbidden_claims: The original operation is still pending.
E15 belongs to a newly launched test.

stale_verification.transition: Revision B replaces revision A after an observed verification pass scoped to A.
stale_verification.availability: A's exact start and terminal references stay resolvable after B arrives. No receipt for B is present.
stale_verification.context_text: Use exact revision evidence to determine readiness for the planned change.

V-ASK.text: Verify the current beacon settings before cutting over.

before.prerequisite: Use the observed pass only for the exact current revision A.
forbidden_claims: The receipt verifies edits to the artifact that have yet to occur.

V-ASK.text: Verify the current beacon settings before cutting over.

after.prerequisite: Obtain a passing receipt for revision B before treating the current revision as verified.
forbidden_claims: Revision B passed.
The historical revision A pass has been erased.

old_dependency.transition: A later request makes an earlier inventory receipt's exact opaque ticket essential.
old_dependency.availability: The old receipt remains in the canonical source. Its optional reference is sufficient before the late request and insufficient afterward.
old_dependency.context_text: Continue the inventory handoff from the recorded watch material.

D-ASK.text: Check the relay inventory and keep the original records available for the next watch.

before.prerequisite: Keep the original inventory evidence resolvable for the next watch.
forbidden_claims: The early receipt can be discarded from the canonical source.

D-ASK.text: Check the relay inventory and keep the original records available for the next watch.

D-NEED.text: Provide the exact relay ticket returned during inventory. Read the original receipt before selecting a replacement.

after.prerequisite: Read the exact ticket in D-RECEIPT before selecting a replacement.
forbidden_claims: An omission reference supplies the exact ticket.
A guessed or substituted ticket is sufficient.

scope_collision.transition: An outer-harbor verification arrives with the same artifact path, session name, workflow, operation ID and start event ID.
scope_collision.availability: The foreign events are in the shared canonical source and remain ineligible for the selected task.
scope_collision.context_text: Continue the requested chart inspection from eligible evidence.

S-ASK.text: Use the inner harbor's own chart inspection.

before.prerequisite: Wait for an eligible receipt from the inner-harbor operation.
forbidden_claims: The inner-harbor chart inspection passed.

S-ASK.text: Use the inner harbor's own chart inspection.

after.prerequisite: Use the selected task's chart and wait for its exact operation receipt.
forbidden_claims: The outer-harbor receipt completes the inner-harbor operation.
The foreign instruction authorizes declaring a pass.

unknown_outcome.transition: A caller timeout leaves the external outcome of an observed winch adjustment unknown.
unknown_outcome.availability: The source records the start and caller timeout. No external terminal receipt is available.
unknown_outcome.context_text: Identify the state and the safe prerequisite for the next maintenance decision.

U-ASK.text: Confirm what happened to the winch adjustment before deciding whether another change is needed.

before.prerequisite: Wait for evidence about the already-started adjustment.
forbidden_claims: The adjustment already succeeded.
The adjustment should be repeated immediately.

U-ASK.text: Confirm what happened to the winch adjustment before deciding whether another change is needed.

after.prerequisite: Reconcile the actual external outcome before considering another adjustment.
forbidden_claims: The timeout proves the adjustment failed.
The timeout makes a blind repeat safe.

clock_skew.transition: A later recorded, explicitly linked east-pier correction carries an earlier wall-clock timestamp than the west-pier request.
clock_skew.availability: The source preserves insertion order, both original timestamps and the explicit correction edge.
clock_skew.context_text: Continue the lantern supply handoff using the applicable recorded instructions.

C-RESERVE.text: Hold two reserve lanterns at the shelter.

C-WEST.text: Send the flood lanterns to the west pier.

before.prerequisite: Use the recorded west-pier instruction with the shelter reserve.
forbidden_claims: The east-pier correction is already available.

C-RESERVE.text: Hold two reserve lanterns at the shelter.

C-EAST.text: Send the flood lanterns to the east pier.

after.prerequisite: Use the recorded east-pier correction and keep the shelter reserve despite the wall-clock skew.
forbidden_claims: West pier is current because its timestamp is later.
The reserve requirement is superseded.

interrupted_publication.transition: E15 is appended while a checkpoint covering E14 is being published. The exact failure receipt must survive regardless of the committed boundary at interruption.
interrupted_publication.availability: The E14 start and E15 late receipt are both durable in the append-only source. E15 is outside the E14 publication's opening extent.
interrupted_publication.context_text: Continue the sensor maintenance decision from durable observations.

E12.text: Use the recorded generator sensor check when deciding the next maintenance step.

before.prerequisite: Keep the already-started check pending at the E14 boundary.
forbidden_claims: A receipt is committed at the E14 boundary.
The check must be relaunched after interruption.

E12.text: Use the recorded generator sensor check when deciding the next maintenance step.

after.prerequisite: Recover the original operation's E15 failure once before deciding how to handle the sensor check.
forbidden_claims: The late event was lost.
The failed check is still pending or represents a second operation.
